purpose: Establish the browser-first App shell under Client ownership without moving Host transport or Runtime mutation authority, and delete the unused standalone Dashboard validation renderer.
constraints: Use git mv for every classified move and delete only classified dead files.
The App shell may render supplied facts and issue requests but owns no Runtime, Git, model, readiness, provenance, or completion authority.
Keep HTTP/SSE process transport and coupled mutation adapters in the frozen legacy Dashboard root until their Host and Runtime contracts are separated.
Rename the moved browser-shell export to App vocabulary without an old-path export or compatibility alias.
Package App assets only from src/clients/app/** and require the old dist/dashboard/assets path to be absent.
